flagged.title: Researching Education
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches that Stephen Ball's Beachside Comprehensive study was non-participant observation and invents a mixed-methods/triangulation design with unstructured interviews for Halsey's survey-only study, both of which would lose marks in an AQA GCSE Sociology exam.

mark_affecting.quote: On the flip side, we have non-participant observation, like Stephen Ball's Beachside Comprehensive research. Here, the researcher just watches from the sidelines.

Sometimes researchers mix things up, which is brilliantly illustrated by Halsey's Origins and Destinations research. He used a mixed-methods approach... followed that up with a second slice of deep unstructured interviews... Halsey was triangulating his data.
